subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Should the permanent block-streaming contract preserve paragraph boundaries as in-band text on chunks, carry explicit boundary metadata through delivery, or accept a narrower text-only repair for common cases?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and two candidate PRs exist, but choosing the durable streaming payload contract affects chunk size limits, coalesced seams, and downstream visible reconstruction.

options.title: Consolidate an in-band text fix
options.body: Choose one candidate or replacement and require it to preserve paragraph separators without doubled newlines across the chunker and coalescer paths.

options.title: Use explicit boundary metadata
options.body: Ask contributors to carry paragraph/newline/hard-split seam metadata through chunking and delivery if text-only chunks cannot satisfy all invariants.

options.title: Accept a partial common-case repair
options.body: Maintainers can land a narrow separator fix and leave near-limit boundary semantics documented as remaining work on this issue.

recommendation.title: Consolidate an in-band text fix
recommendation.body: Choose one candidate or replacement and require it to preserve paragraph separators without doubled newlines across the chunker and coalescer paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has strong recent history around coalescing, streaming docs, and chunking hardening, making it the best available owner for the contract choice.
